title: SDK payment collection flow (MVP manual process)
desc: How to receive payment and activate a customer license at MVP stage before Stripe automation. Korean market focus: Toss or bank transfer. Steps cover payment receipt, GitHub invite send, and record keeping.
steps: RECEIVE PAYMENT: accept Kakao Pay, Toss, or domestic bank transfer (Shinhan/Kookmin). Share account number in onboarding email. Amount: 100,000 KRW/mo (CDP/Pro) or 500,000 KRW/mo (Sudo/Business). No receipt system at MVP -- manual bank statement verification.

PENDING INVITE UX: before acceptance, wkappbot shows blue toast bottom-right (non-blocking, 15s auto-dismiss, CDP works immediately). LicenseManager checks GET /repos/invitations when permission=none.

requirements.expect: shows read permission for active customer
